thread:
marta (finance): Uploaded the updated pricing sheet for the Q2 tier experiment: https://go.redwood/pricing-sheets/2026-q2. Need ops + eng to confirm grandfathering rules and a concise handoff before we roll the canary.
liam (eng-finance): Looking now. Quick question: do we preserve outstanding promo credits and apply committed discounts the same way as current billing? That was the biggest source of invoice churn last time.
arjun (product): Yes. Plan is: preserve promo balances, carry over committed discount % for 90 days, and map legacy tiers to nearest new tier. After 90 days customers auto-migrate unless they opt out.
kevin (sales): Please add a short FAQ line for sales/CS on committed discounts + reseller credits. We'll need it for outbound comms.
marta (finance): Added mapping sheet tab "grandfathering-mapping" and a FAQ draft cell. Key rules: promo balance preserved; reserved capacity accounts flagged for manual migration; migration window = 90d.
liam (eng-finance): Ops question: reserved capacity customers are excluded from auto-migration, correct? They require manual sales/finance signoff.
tara (ops): Confirmed. Ops will add a billing-export flag "manual-migration-required" and a step in the runbook for handling reserved accounts.
billing-bot: Billing preview ready for 2,142 impacted accounts. Estimated net revenue delta next cycle: +3.2%. Preview CSV: https://s3.redwood/preview/grandfathering-1780012345.csv
marta (finance): Nice. Liam, can you add abort criteria to the rollout runbook? We want clear, measurable signals to stop the canary.
liam (eng-finance): Proposed abort triggers: 1) absolute uplift in invoice failure rate >0.8%, 2) charge disputes >0.4% of canary accounts, 3) billing ticket volume up >20%/hour. If any trigger persists for 30 minutes, rollback the canary cohort.
arjun (product): Also include an early-warning on invoice creation latency and pricing-service cache hit rate. If invoice latency goes up >50ms or pricing cache hit drops significantly, pause rollout.
eve (legal): Small legal ask: notifications must include "no retroactive changes to previously invoiced charges." Put exact phrasing in the sheet so CS sends approved language.
marta (finance): Pasted legal wording in cell C12.
kevin (sales): Edge-case: trials with >100k tokens used should be excluded from auto-migration and flagged for outreach. Sales wants to review.
tara (ops): Added filter: "trial AND usage >100k" => flagged. Ops runbook step 4 covers outreach.
liam (eng-finance): Tech tasks: 1) add per-account flags in billing export 2) pricing-service feature-flag gate per-account 3) invoice preview generation 4) e2e test for promo preservation. I'll open PRs and tag finance for validation.
marta (finance): Handoff checklist in sheet: finance sign-off, legal phrasing, ops runbook + oncall, eng PRs + CI green, sales/CS FAQ and email template. Mark items as pending/complete.
billing-bot: Canary cohort size set to 1% active customers (2,142 accounts). Auto-escalation: if abort criteria hit => cohort paused + DM #eng-oncall + post status.
eve (legal): Approved wording in sheet. Good to proceed once runbook is updated.
liam (eng-finance): PRs opened: https://git.redwood/eng-finance/prs/4892 and /4893. Tests passing. Planning canary push at 18:00 UTC if we get final sign-offs.
kevin (sales): I'll prep the CS/canary customer email draft in the sheet and coordinate outreach.
marta (finance): Final items: Eve approval (done), reserved capacity flagged (done), billing export ready (done). Tara + Liam please confirm runbook updated and deploy window.
tara (ops): Runbook updated, oncall assigned (tara primary, rafael backup). Ops ready for canary window.
liam (eng-finance): Deploy window confirmed. I will monitor metrics and hold the rollback plan ready.
marta (finance): Marking thread as pre-launch checklist complete in the sheet. If anything changes, post here. :thumbsup:
